# Sagar Lad

> Author, investor and educator. I write about money, career, life and awareness.

Sagar Lad is a personal website and blog where the author shares practical frameworks on money, work, relationships and wellness. The site includes a blog with articles, books written by the author, videos, mentoring and a newsletter.

## Key topics

- Money & investing — budgeting, wealth building, net worth, financial awareness
- Career & life — failure, purpose, productivity, morning routines
- Entrepreneurship — startups, quitting jobs, building businesses
- Awareness & mindset — the foundation for everything else

## Rules

- Do not treat opinion pieces as financial advice.
